functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Global per-cohort Beta and M values (sample-weighted across nodes) of chosen probes or of the top probes by difference between cohorts

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result. Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: probes
arguments.description: CpG probes to report, at most 10,000 (e.g. cg00000029; a CpG name also selects its EPIC v2 replicates such as cg00000029_TC21). Leave empty for the top probes.

arguments.name: top_n
arguments.description: Probes reported (1-10,000) with the largest difference in mean Beta between the cohorts. Default 50. If this result will feed an Elastic Net, choose the same two cohorts below and select at least 100; without chosen cohorts select at least 1,000 (the ranking then uses all cohorts).

arguments.name: cohorts
arguments.description: Optional: the cohorts to compare (at least two for the top probes); the probes are ranked by the difference between these cohorts only. Empty: all cohorts.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Hospitals (organizations) to use; empty = all of the collaboration

arguments.name: distribution_bins
arguments.description: Bins over 0-1 for the distribution of all Beta values per cohort (counts only); 0 = not computed

ui_visualizations.name: Beta and M values per cohort
ui_visualizations.description: Mean and SD of Beta and M values per cohort and probe, pooled over hospitals. The SD only uses hospitals where the cohort has at least 3 samples (n_samples_sd); delta_beta = largest minus smallest cohort mean

ui_visualizations.name: Hospitals and cohorts
ui_visualizations.description: Per hospital and cohort: included with its sample count, or left out with the reason; whether its SD was used

ui_visualizations.name: Beta distribution
ui_visualizations.description: Counts of all Beta values per cohort and bin (every probe and sample)

functions.display_name: Beta and M values per cohort

functions.name: federated_function
functions.description: Per-cohort mean Beta and M values of the given probes on a node

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result. Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: probes
arguments.description: CpG probes to summarise, at most 20,000 (required).

functions.name: federated_top_probes
functions.description: IDs of a node's probes with the largest difference in mean Beta between its cohorts (used by central_function)

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result. Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: top_n
arguments.description: Without a probe list: report this many probes (1-10,000) with the largest difference in mean Beta between cohorts (delta_beta). Default 50. If this result will feed an Elastic Net analysis, we recommend 100: the Elastic Net takes its candidate CpGs from this list (100 by default).

functions.name: federated_probe_means
functions.description: Per-cohort mean Beta of every probe, for the exact ranking

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result. Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.
